ai_summary: Apollo Pipes Limited is undertaking a significant strategic diversification by investing up to ₹300 crores to establish subsidiary(ies) for entering the tiles and ceramics business. Concurrently, the company plans to raise ₹189.10 crores through a preferential issue of warrants to eight identified non-promoter investors, leading to a 6.31% equity dilution upon full conversion. This substantial venture into a new, capital-intensive industry carries inherent operational and market risks, while the precise allocation of the raised funds towards this new business is not explicitly detailed.
